GEOGRAPHY — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

4. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   B. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   D. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.
   C. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.

6. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   D. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   D. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   C. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

13. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   B. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   B. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.

15. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   B. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   C. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Underground Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Karst Scenery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
